selection_criteria: mission requested capability, availability, credentials, portfolio, and assessments
source_basis.coverage_basis: Only fields allowed by the consent policy and selected by mission-fit projection rules are included.

projection_method.compression_basis: The projection exposes allowed fields and records denied fields through the decision log.

known_blind_spots: Projection is not a whole-twin view.
Projection is not a complete work-history audit.

freshness_window.revalidation_ref: re-run projection when mission, consent policy, or twin source changes

repair.revalidation_path: inspect projection decision log and regenerate projection from current consent policy

non_claims: This profile does not certify the entire twin.
This profile does not claim omitted or denied fields are absent from the source twin.
This profile does not authorize downstream promotion outside the allowed uses.
